evals.prompt: I already scaffolded a Scaffold HBAR app (packages/nextjs present, yarn workspaces) and harness.yaml is committed. Help me create a hedera-harness spec for an HCS proof-wall feature called proof-wall: users browse a public message wall without a wallet, and posting requires connecting a wallet. No Solidity.
evals.expected_output: A grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, looks up project facts instead of asking, pushes for element ids and loading/failure states, waits for shared understanding, then writes a markdown spec to specs/proof-wall.md and hands off with harness run --spec.

checks.name: one-question-at-a-time
checks.value: (one question|one at a time|Ask.*one|waiting for|recommended answer)
checks.description: Follows the grilling protocol: one question at a time with a recommendation

checks.name: waits-for-shared-understanding
checks.description: Does not write files until shared understanding is confirmed

checks.name: writes-markdown-spec-path
checks.description: Writes the spec as markdown under specs/

checks.name: asks-for-element-ids
checks.description: Pushes for concrete element ids so claims become machine checks

checks.name: covers-loading-or-failure-state
checks.description: Asks what shows while loading and when the request fails

checks.name: hands-off-with-run-spec
checks.description: Hands off with the v3 run command

checks.name: no-recipe-schema-version
checks.description: Does not emit a schemaVersion recipe field, which harness 3.x does not read

checks.name: no-recipe-yaml-path
checks.description: Does not write the removed .harness/spec.yaml recipe file

checks.name: no-prd-file
checks.description: Does not write a PRD, which harness 3.x has no concept of

evals.prompt: I want to use hedera-harness on my Next.js Hedera app but I honestly do not know what feature to build first or how to describe it. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to harness wizard, which reads the project, proposes the four commands and interviews them into a spec, rather than grilling them from scratch in the conversation.

checks.name: recommends-wizard
checks.description: Routes to the built-in interviewer instead of hand-grilling

checks.name: explains-wizard-reads-project
checks.description: Says what the wizard does: reads the project and interviews

checks.name: mentions-review-after
checks.description: Suggests reviewing the drafted spec afterwards

evals.prompt: My project has a .harness/spec.yaml with schemaVersion 3, a prd.md and validators/static.json from when we used hedera-harness 1.2. I just upgraded to harness 3.0.1. Migrate my recipe to the new version.
evals.expected_output: Explains that harness 3.x does not read the recipe at all so there is nothing to migrate mechanically, and that the two v3 inputs are harness.yaml (written by init or wizard) and a markdown spec.

checks.name: says-recipe-is-ignored
checks.value: (ignore[sd]?|does not read|no longer read|not read at all|nothing to migrate)
checks.description: States that harness 3.x ignores the old recipe rather than migrating it

checks.name: names-harness-yaml
checks.description: Names the v3 config file

checks.name: names-the-four-commands
checks.description: Names the four commands harness.yaml carries

checks.name: recommends-init-not-handwriting
checks.description: Has init or wizard write harness.yaml rather than hand-writing it

checks.name: no-migrate-command
checks.description: Does not invent a migrate command

evals.prompt: Write me a harness spec for a balance widget. Requirements: the hook polls the mirror node every 10 seconds, the component is memoised so it never re-renders unnecessarily, and the balance never shows undefined.
evals.expected_output: Converts each unobservable claim into something a judge that cannot see the code could check: an update cadence observed in the browser, and what the element actually displays instead of a negative claim.

checks.name: flags-unobservable-claims
checks.description: Identifies that implementation claims cannot be judged

checks.name: rewrites-polling-claim
checks.description: Converts the polling claim into an observable update cadence

checks.name: rewrites-negative-claim
checks.description: Replaces the never-shows-undefined claim with what the element does show

checks.name: drops-or-reframes-memoisation
checks.description: Addresses the memoisation claim rather than silently passing it through

checks.name: names-an-element-id
checks.description: Gives the displayed value a concrete element id

evals.prompt: Here is my feature idea for harness: a /status page showing the network name in #network-name. My repo has no harness.yaml yet. Write the spec and whatever config is needed.
evals.expected_output: Writes the markdown spec but has harness init or wizard produce harness.yaml rather than hand-writing it, and notes the clean-tree and package.json requirements DOCTOR enforces.

checks.name: defers-config-to-init
checks.description: Has init or wizard write harness.yaml

checks.name: explains-why-not-handwritten
checks.description: Says why init should write it: it reads the project and commits the file

checks.name: writes-spec-file
checks.description: Still writes the markdown spec

checks.name: mentions-doctor-preconditions
checks.description: Flags the preconditions DOCTOR enforces before a run
